(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  have hpair : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by
    intro A
    by_cases hA : A ∈ P
    · exact Or.inl hA
    · right
      by_contra hAc
      have hn : ¬ ∀ U ∈ P, A ∩ U ≠ ∅ := fun h => hPS ⟨A, hA, h⟩
      push_neg at hn
      obtain ⟨U, hU, hAU⟩ := hn
      apply hPS
      refine ⟨Aᶜ, hAc, ?_⟩
      intro V hV
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr (hPP U hU V hV)
      have hxA : x ∉ A := by
        intro hxA
        have : x ∈ A ∩ U := ⟨hxA, hx.1⟩
        rw [hAU] at this
        exact this
      exact Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 ⟨x, by simp [hxA, hx.2]⟩

    intro A hA hAc
    have h := hPP A hA Aᶜ hAc
    simpa using h
  let Q : Finset (Set S) := Finset.univ \ P
  have hcard : P.card = Q.card := by
    apply Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ)
    · intro A hA
      simp only [Q, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]

    · intro A hA

      rcases hpair A with h | h
      · exact False.elim (hA h)
      · exact h
    · intro A hA
      simp

      simp

    rw [← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1 ≤ Fintype.card S)]
